feeds.title: Texas Storm Chasers
feeds.description: Texas Storm Chasers began as a simple website meant to share our amateur storm chase videos. They have evolved into a brand that assists in the distribution of life-saving weather information and some pretty cool storm chasing content too. Follow this blog for more updates related to the storm chasing.

feeds.title: Storm Highway
feeds.description: Storm Highway covers extreme weather year-round in the Midwest, Great Plains and beyond. I focus primarily on the storm hazard during the winter months and the midwestern severe weather threat throughout the year. Get more information about storm chasing by following this feed.

feeds.title: Virginia Storm Chasing Blog
feeds.description: Virginia Storm Chasing is a blog that deals with the severe storms that hit in the Old Dominion! Follow to get regular updates from this blog in your inbox.

feeds.title: Illinois Storm Chasers Blog
feeds.description: Illinois Storm Chasers blog has a group of meteorologists and storm chasers dedicated to giving you our best effort when mother nature is at her worst! This blog aims to provide accurate, easy to understand weather information for the state of Illinois.

feeds.title: NNWX.US
feeds.description: NNWX.US is a website and blog of Storm Chaser created by Nick Nolte. Get more articles related to storm chasing by following this blog.

feeds.title: Tornado Titans
feeds.description: Tornado Titans chase down the world's wildest weather then use those images to make content to teach others about weather. Follow this blog for more updates.

feeds.title: StormChasingUSA blog
feeds.description: Storm Chasing USA compares storm chasing tours. Read reviews, compare prices, get inspired, get informed. Everything you need to know before you book your tour! Follow this blog for some storm chasing experience.

feeds.title: Extreme Storms Blog
feeds.description: Extreme Storms Blog refers to the Storm Chasing and Storm Chasers of extreme storms. Informs about the severe weather across Australia and Tornado Alley. Follow to get the latest articles from this feed in your inbox.

feeds.title: Higgins Storm Chasing
feeds.description: Higgins Storm Chasing is a weather business page where we share photos, forecasts, alerts and updates in QLD and right across Australia. We aim to increase community preparation, awareness, support, and recovery, before, during and after weather events or natural disasters occur. Follow this blog for more updates.

feeds.title: Kyle Brittain's Weather & Storm Chase Blog
feeds.description: The author is a Storm Chaser, a graduate of Penn State's Weather Forecasting certificate program, and overall weather and geography, enthusiast. This blog includes the thoughts before, during, and after the occurrence of a storm and much more. Follow this blog for more updates.

feeds.title: Jon Davies Severe Weather Notes
feeds.description: I'm a meteorologist with 35 years experience in weather and a number of published papers. I continue to be fascinated with the challenges of forecasting tornadoes and severe weather, supplemented by occasional storm chasing.

feeds.title: Severe Videos
feeds.description: Severe Videos was founded by Scott Chaser Curry in 2015 as a way to feature his most severe videos captured while storm chasing. Follow this blog to get more updates on storm chasing.
